description: Explicit fresh-walker controls on the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Positive window and aggregate discovery must retain ordinary behavior; the broad IN-list query exceeds the rejected prototype's 1024-unit syntax threshold without deep recursion. Fresh SQL runs only on unprepared query/eager and wrapper lanes with the existing --fresh-sql protocol. Main multiway-plan.json SQL and schedules are unchanged.

workloads.name: positive_window
workloads.sql: SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS position FROM items WHERE id < $1 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: ordinary_aggregate
workloads.sql: SELECT bucket, count(*) AS n, sum(score) AS total FROM items WHERE id < $1 GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

workloads.name: fresh_sql
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score + 7 AS adjusted FROM items WHERE id = $1
